category: inference gateway, free models with a daily weighted-unit cap

free_tier.notes: longer inputs use more daily units; site-wide free cap 20 requests per minute; 2 concurrent free requests per account; an additional IP guard applies

tooling: OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.bazaarlink.ai/v1; auto:free routes to a free model
chaining: at $5 of credit the paid tier raises the request rate to 200 per minute
